name: SHAK-12
description:
The SHAK12, originally called the ASH12, is a Zarovian bullpup battle rifle chambered for the 12.7x55mm STS-130 cartridge designed to combine high stopping power with relatively limited penetration to avoid collateral damage in urban combat.While it shares a lot of design similarities with the VKS sniper rifle, the two do not use interchangeable ammunition.

Model submitted by Mysterious Modeler X
